For the repair cafe, I need to turn sign-up lines into a volunteer rota. Write Python code for parse_signup(line) that accepts "name,skill,hours", trims whitespace, rejects an empty name, and requires hours to be an integer from 1 to 6. Return a dataclass. Then write a function that totals hours by skill without mutating the input. Include unit tests covering malformed rows and repeated skills, and explain one design tradeoff.
